adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration does `execute("SELECT c.id ... WHERE s.name = 'embed_category'")[0]['id']` without checking whether the SQL returned any rows. If there is no `site_settings` row for `embed_category` (likely, since Discourse persists only overridden settings and the diff also removes `embed_category` from site_settings.yml) or if no matching category exists, the `PG::Result` will be empty and indexing `[0]` can raise, aborting the migration. Because migrations run in a transaction on Postgres, an exception would roll back the earlier `create_table :embeddable_hosts`, leaving the table missing; the diff also changes runtime checks to call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (e.g. EmbedController#ensure_embeddable and TopicRetriever#invalid_host?), which would then fail if the table was never created due to the migration aborting.
